Deterministic gate US-001-C1 (python scripts/probe_venues.py --out ...) exits 0, and write_report() in scripts/probe_venues.py writes the JSON result file.

This test asserts the set of venues in results equals the configured VENUES set; combined with probe_all()'s unconditional list-comprehension append (scripts/probe_venues.py) and test_probe_records_a_transport_failure_as_a_result_rather_than_raising showing an erroring venue still yields a row rather than being dropped or raising, omission on error is structurally precluded.
Test raises TimeoutError from the opener and asserts the resulting row has http_status None and an error string containing 'TimeoutError: timed out'.

No CI run status is provided in the deterministic gate results, and the committed evidence file itself records github_actions: false / github_run_id: null, meaning the last generation was local, not on a GitHub-hosted runner — no proof the workflow actually ran green.
Deterministic gate US-001-C5 exits 0, confirming all eight required venue keys are present in results.

Deterministic gate US-001-C6 exits 0 for the current commit; the committed reachability.json shows all 8 venues with integer http_status 200, well above the 6-venue threshold (the stale gates.json/verdict.json in the diff reflect an earlier failed attempt, superseded by the latest commit 0b57517).

verdict.note: Five of six criteria are met with direct evidence from tests and passing deterministic gates on the current commit. C4 (CI) fails: no green workflow run is evidenced, and the committed reachability.json explicitly records github_actions:false, indicating the artifact was produced locally, not by the GitHub-hosted runner the criterion requires.

gate.question: US-001 has failed 3 times — is the story wrong?
gate.context:
Criteria judged not met:
  - US-001-C4: No CI run status is provided in the deterministic gate results, and the committed evidence file itself records github_actions: false / github_run_id: null, meaning the last generation was local, not on a GitHub-hosted runner — no proof the workflow actually ran green.

data.reason: Criteria were genuinely wrong and have been rewritten. C1 regenerated reachability.json locally during verification, overwriting the artifact produced on the GitHub runner - the criterion meant to prove the probe runs destroyed the evidence the story exists to produce, which is why C4 saw github_actions:false. Local and CI evidence are now separate committed files, plus a new criterion asserting the CI file carries its own github_run_id so a local regeneration cannot satisfy it. Attempts 1-2 were consumed by codex 404ing on gpt-5.5 (implementer never ran, $0, 0 tokens), not by the spec. All criteria verified passing by hand: CI success on HEAD cf7fc94, 8/8 venues with real HTTP status, 5 tests passing.
